header.publisher: Internal Revenue Service (HSA); retirement-plan limits projected from Milliman/Marsh forecasts
lawRefs: IRC 415(d), 219(b)(5), 408A(c)(3), 414(v) (cost-of-living adjustment rules used for the projection)
header.notes: sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (JSON.stringify of the file without `header`). As of 2026-11-10 the IRS had NOT published the 2027 retirement-plan cost-of-living notice (successor to Notice 2025-67): irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/n-26-60 through n-26-80 were probed and the IRS COLA table page still ends at 2026. Retirement-plan amounts are therefore projections computed from CPI through September 2026: the 401(k)/415 amounts match the final Milliman and Marsh forecasts as reported by 401kspecialistmag.com; IRA and SIMPLE amounts and IRA phase-out ranges are from thefinancebuff.com calculations (updated 2026-10-14). Replace with the IRS notice when issued. HSA amounts are final (Rev. Proc. 2026-24, sha256 of raw PDF bcb6b41a835b84d4315f738a7250801831021829e39d70225424e2f45afcb715). rothCatchUpWageThreshold is the 2026-wages threshold governing 2027 catch-ups. MFS IRA ranges, hsa.catchUp55, sep.pctOfCompensation, rollover529ToRoth and iBondPurchaseCap are statutory/regulatory and unchanged.
